canonical_project: Microsoft Hyderabad data centre region (Mekaguda & Shadnagar campuses)
notes: Microsoft announced in Mar 2022 a 22-acre site at Mekaguda village (Rangareddy district, near Hyderabad airport) under its Rs 15,000 crore Hyderabad data centre region investment over 15 years; also acquired a 41-acre parcel at Shadnagar (Rangareddy). HYD01 at Mekaguda was ~70% built as of Jul 2024 with operations expected by 2025; a new 220-kV grid line was planned to serve it.
